The rows currently carry no declared state, so they cannot be labeled.

TASK. Add a `declared_state` object to every row that has one available, and show it on the blind sheet. If a row's declared state cannot be recovered from recorded fields, set declared_state to null and say why in `declared_state_missing_reason`; never guess. Authored rows inherit the declared_state of their source row. The blind sheet (`--blind-sheet`) must print, under each narration, a line `Declared: ...` rendered from declared_state in neutral words that do NOT contain the thing's name (use 'the object'), the source file, or any label word; sheets stay shuffled with a fixed seed.
